response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count FROM Invoices i INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), summary AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) as total_orders, COUNT(*) as distinct_genders FROM gender_counts) SELECT gc.gender, gc.order_count, gc.order_count * 1.0 / s.total_orders as share, (gc.order_count * 1.0 / s.total_orders) - (1.0 / s.distinct_genders) as above_average FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN summary s WHERE gc.order_count * 1.0 / s.total_orders > 1.0 / s.distinct_genders ORDER BY gc.gender
